Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Retail supervisors annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers ($62,170). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $62,170, Austin $49,730, Chicago $48,900. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Retail supervisors?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers (26,770 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 26,770, Seattle 15,250, Austin 7,950. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Retail supervisors most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (1.01). Published LQs: Seattle 1.01, Austin 0.85, Chicago 0.82.

What is the hourly median for Retail supervisors in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $23.91; Chicago $23.51; Seattle $29.89. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
